pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Yeti Hideout.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: This is Skor, distinct from the Luminous Beasts Yeti. Arrows retain 15% of initial damage and trident damage retains 30%; this is reduction, not immunity. Spawning, certain rage states and a long ground-smash action reject normal damage. Wait for the action to finish and use the melee opening.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Arrows retain 15% of initial damage and trident damage retains 30%; this is reduction, not immunity. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Skor Gauntlet. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
